architectures.architecture: Separate integrated EO and SWIR telescopes

architectures.coating_throughput: independent channel coatings; no dichroic loss
architectures.thermal_focus: two independent focus/athermalisation loops; lowest optical coupling
architectures.gimbal_integration: widest front face; two LOS datums; possible parallax but modular service
architectures.c1_gate: fresh SWIR seed plus integrated boresight/parallax and structure model
architectures.bbox_classification: C0 hypothesis range, not a CAD envelope or customer limit
